title: Choosing fibre blankets for a high-temperature bogie-hearth furnace: 1400-grade material versus furnace temperature
summary: Two Suneng 2024 high-temperature bogie-hearth furnace proposals for steel components specify an additional layer of type 1400 zirconia-containing fibre blanket at the junction between heating strips and zirconia-alumina fibre modules. The clause identifies a local material location, not a 1400°C whole-furnace operating temperature. Review the modules, local blanket layer and heating-strip mounting together.
